title: Festive Christmas Street Clipart Set
author: daphnepopuliers
description:
///// THIS SET CONTAINS
– 40 digital clipart images
– including houses, trees, flower arrangements, leaves, berries, snowmen, ornaments, paint smear, text image, candle, cupcakes, cookies, hot chocolate mug
– you will receive the clipart in PNG files (with a transparent background)
– high resolution (300 dpi)
– size of images is at least 2500 pixels at the largest side, size of other side varies according to shape
– great for your personal and/or commercial creative projects (in printed or digital format)
///// USING & EDITING YOUR FILES
PNG files are NOT layered, you can not change specific details of the file. You can however create other image files with them, like posters, cards and other printable products. Please keep in mind that for working with clipart you need to use image editing software! Make sure you have this kind of software and you know how to work with it! Thanks!
///// ABOUT THE SHOP
The Dutch Lady Designs is a small graphic design company based in The Netherlands, it is registered with the Dutch Chamber of Commerce.
